title.en: Localize the member dashboard in all twelve languages
title.zh: 完整本地化十二语言会员仪表盘

purpose.en: Remove the English fallback from the signed-in dashboard while preserving learner-authored values and SmartLingo data boundaries.
purpose.zh: 移除登录后仪表盘的英文回退，同时保护学员输入值与 SmartLingo 数据边界。

en: Provide prebuilt dashboard interface copy for every non-English locale.
Localize dynamic interface text and accessibility attributes without rewriting inputs or textareas.
zh: 为每种非英语站点语言提供预构建仪表盘界面文案。
本地化动态界面与无障碍属性，同时不改写输入框或文本域。

en: Member dashboard, Today’s Sprint, learning hub, membership panel, and text-size controls
zh: 会员仪表盘、今日速成、学习中心、会员面板及文字大小控件

en: Add a mutation-aware locale runtime backed by public prebuilt copy.
Use the active twelve-language locale throughout dashboard components, including dynamic duration and tab labels.
Exclude learner email, course titles, native language names, inputs, and textareas from translation.
zh: 新增由公开预构建文案驱动的动态语言运行时。
在全部仪表盘组件中使用当前十二语言设置，包括动态时长与标签名称。
排除学员邮箱、课程标题、语言本名、输入框与文本域。

en: Run type checking, dashboard localization contracts, shared input audit, production build, and deployment verification.
Use real Chrome on Japanese and Korean dashboard surfaces after deployment.
zh: 执行类型检查、仪表盘语言契约、共享输入审计、生产构建与部署核验。
部署后用真实 Chrome 检查日语和韩语仪表盘。

en: Learner-authored course data remains displayed as authored; this release localizes the platform interface and built-in planner content.
zh: 学员自行创建的课程数据仍按原文显示；本次发布本地化平台界面与内置规划器内容。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's twelve target-language courses, five-skill learning model, anonymous trial, SmartCards, Sprint, and reward-point isolation.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 十二目标语言课程、五项技能学习模式、匿名试学、智慧卡、速成及积分隔离。
